comment.cs: Vláda odmítla ETS2 usnesením na prvním zasedání (16. 12. 2025) a aktivně jedná na úrovni EU. Kritici (Nerudová, právníci) upozorňují, že pouhé usnesení bez implementace legislativy může vést k sankcím EU.
comment.en: The government rejected ETS2 by resolution at its first meeting (16 Dec 2025) and is actively negotiating at EU level. Babiš announces concrete solutions for the February European Council summit, but no actual legislative steps to reject the system have been implemented yet. Critics (Nerudová, lawyers) warn that a mere resolution without legislative implementation may lead to EU sanctions.

comment.cs: Vláda formálně odmítla migrační pakt usnesením na prvním zasedání v prosinci 2025. Pakt je však právně závazný pro všechny členy EU a bez rámce jednotné politiky jej Česko nemůže jednostranně zrušit. Česko si zajistilo výjimku z povinné solidarity pro rok 2026, ale pakt vstoupil v platnost 12. června 2026 a Česko jej implementuje.
comment.en: The government formally rejected the migration pact by resolution at its first meeting in December 2025. However, the pact is legally binding on all EU members and the Czech Republic cannot unilaterally abolish it without a unified policy framework. The Czech Republic secured an exemption from mandatory solidarity for 2026, but the pact entered into force on June 12, 2026, and the Czech Republic is implementing it.

comment.cs: Ano, splněno: Daňové odpočty na VaV byly od 1. 1. 2026 skutečně zatraktivněny – zvýšení z 100 % na 150 % do 50 mil. Kč, prodloužení lhůty uplatnění z 3 na 5 let a flexibilnější pravidla. comment.en: Yes, fulfilled: R&D tax deductions were indeed made more attractive from 1 January 2026 – increase from 100% to 150% up to 50 million CZK, extension of the application period from 3 to 5 years, and more flexible rules. The measure was approved by the previous government but took effect under the Babiš government. However, practical effectiveness remains limited: companies are reluctant to use the deduction due to unpredictable tax audits and formal requirements.
